description: Find the photos in a collection that contain the person in a query image (typically a selfie) or a 512-number embedding. Returns matches [{photo_id, score}] best first, plus photo_ids. When nothing matches, `reason` says why: no_face (no face found in the query) or low_quality_selfie. Costs 93 credits.

embedding.description: A 512-number face embedding (from register_selfie) instead of an image.

file_path.description: Path to the query face image on this computer (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF or HEIC).

gcs_key.description: Object key of the query face image on the CDN configured for your account (instead of a URL).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry that reuses the key is never charged twice: if the first call finished, the retry gets 409 duplicate_request_already_processed; if it is still running, 409 duplicate_request_in_flight. Use a new key for each different request.

image_base64.description: The query face image as base64 (a data: URL is fine). Up to 30 MB decoded. Prefer image_url for large files.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the query face image. SightRadar downloads it; it must be reachable from the internet.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a match (0-1). Omit to use the calibrated default.

name: search_faces
title: Search a collection by face
